justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/DocBuilder.java, OpenOp.java, CloseOp.java, Doc.java, Op.java, and core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/Formatter.java. DocBuilder is small (5 methods) and its outgoing dependencies are limited to Doc, Indent, ArrayDeque, List, and MoreObjects. Its incoming use is also narrow: OpenOp and CloseOp each delegate one call, Doc.java’s four Op leaf types delegate to it, and Formatter.java creates a single instance to build one Doc. The references are concentrated in the formatting pipeline rather than spread broadly across the codebase, so there is not strong fan-in/fan-out evidence for a hub-like modularization smell.
